cross_check.name: vmangos / brotalnia world_full_14_june_2021.sql
cross_check.note: Used only to cross-check spawn guids, positions, movement type and addon emote/stand states. GPL-2.0 core; the data dump carries no separate licence. Nothing is copied from it except the per-spawn flags in the crosscheck field and the six-kid positions.
cross_check.result: Every Goldshire spawn shares its guid with CMaNGOS and matches within 1 yd except where noted. No friendly Goldshire NPC has a non-zero emote_state in either database (the only emote states near the inn are Darkmoon Faire carnies). Wowhead Classic pages agree on title and zone only; they publish no coordinates.

client_verification.dbc_chain: patch-2.MPQ > patch.MPQ > dbc.MPQ (patch.MPQ overrides dbc.MPQ for CreatureDisplayInfo, CreatureDisplayInfoExtra, CreatureModelData, AnimationData, EmotesTextSound)
client_verification.result: All 71 display ids used by the 204 non-event spawns exist in the client CreatureDisplayInfo.dbc. The seasonal spawns (Darkmoon Faire, Winter Veil, Lunar Festival) also resolve.
client_verification.display_kinds: kind=character: CreatureDisplayInfo.ExtraDisplayInfoID is set, so race/sex/skin/face/hair and baked equipment come from CreatureDisplayInfoExtra on a Character\* model (HumanMale/HumanFemale, full animation set). kind=creature: a plain Creature\* model with its own textures; the kid models have only Stand, Walk, Run.

meta.equip_display_ids_order: CreatureDisplayInfoExtra order: helm, shoulder, shirt, cuirass, legs, boots, wrists, gloves, tabard, cape (ItemDisplayInfo ids, 0 = empty)
meta.legal: Facts only (ids, coordinates, names, flags). No Blizzard art or DBC bytes are copied; the displays table records ids and model path strings.
meta.excluded: 40 event-only spawns (Darkmoon Faire Elwynn, Winter Veil, Lunar Festival) are summarised in seasonal_event_spawns and left out of spawns.

notable_cast.note: No entry-68 spawn within 300 yd. Goldshire uses "Stormwind Guard" (entry 1423, display 3258 M / 3257 F): 2 stationary posts beside Marshal Dughan, plus waypoint patrols farther out (extended_patrols).

Goldshire kids: Bo (waypoint loop by the smithy), Mark and Joshua (random wander by the east chickens), Matt (by the fishing pole, lake side), and the group Cameron/John/Dana/Jose/Lisa/Aaron near Helene Peltskinner. No "orphan" NPCs in the DB.
None in the 1.12 database within 300 yd. Barkeep Dobbins (bartender) holds a bottle (item 2717) and Remy Two Times / Remen Marcot are the nearest equivalents.
